reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Two em dashes. One joined the two halves of the governing question and became a sentence break plus a comma, so the question can be asked directly. One was appositive before the address and became a period.
Truly evolved becomes genuinely evolved, deepest hope becomes hope, and precisely becomes exactly. All three are on the card's reduce list.
The protected line A blueprint is not a prophecy is present verbatim and is the one protected line in this volume that the baseline already contained.
The governing question in full, the errors as an offering, and the address to the reader who may see more lucidly.

openQuestions: Voice card exemplar anchors. The Volume VI card lists opening anchors drawn from the compressed pass rather than from the baseline, so a faithful re-render displaces some of them. Four of the card's five protected lines were also authored by the pass and do not exist in the baseline at all; all four are kept verbatim. The card needs re-preparation against the re-rendered source, and that is a card revision the author should authorise.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus card, the volume-06 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The dedication is the only section in Volume VI where the ledger is silent and the card's reduce list did all the work. Three words came out and one hundred and twenty-eight words of address came back, which is the ratio the standard's proportionality rule describes.
